typography_notes: Sans-serif font throughout. Title is bold and larger than body. Mathematical expressions use italic serif-style math font. Some variables like Net_j appear in red. Handwritten annotations in blue ink.

recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light gray (#e6e6e6). 2. Add title 'Remember: Derivative of Sigmoid Function' in blue bold sans-serif at top-left. 3. Add handwritten blue 'O_j:' annotation to the left of the first equation box. 4. Create a cream rounded rectangle (#fffacd) with equation f(Net_j)=1/(1+e^{-Net_j}). 5. Create a neuron diagram: circle with Σ, red dot, red 'Net_j' label, arrow to square box. 6. Create a light green rounded rectangle (#ccffcc) with f(x)=1/(1+e^{-x}). 7. Insert sigmoid graph in blue frame at top-right with axes from -6 to 6 and 0.0 to 1.0. 8. Add yellow circle with '4' at top-right corner. 9. Create stacked white equation boxes for the derivative derivations, transcribing each line exactly including the bullet dot and comma in numerators. 10. Add red double arrow ⇒ before the final peach box (#ffe4c4) containing f'(Net_j)=O_j(1-O_j). 11. Add blue handwritten mark under the arrow. 12. Use black sans-serif for body text, red for Net_j variables, blue for handwritten elements.
